name: io.github.MeMikko/hoodgrow-mcp
description: Robinhood Chain stock token data — price, adjusted supply, corporate actions.

environment_variables.name: HOODGROW_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Bearer API key issued by HoodGrow (DM https://x.com/hoodgrow). Optional if HOODGROW_PRIVATE_KEY is set instead.

environment_variables.name: HOODGROW_PRIVATE_KEY
environment_variables.description: EVM private key used to pay per call via x402 instead of a bearer key. Optional if HOODGROW_API_KEY is set instead.
